notes.title: “Hatsune Miku Logic Paint S+” is out now!
notes.content:
[p]Step into the world of puzzles with Hatsune Miku and the Piapro Characters!
Solve puzzles to collect stunning artwork, catchy songs, and stylish costumes!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693931/797e02fcc6afe0766eeb40a5ca5492af5a96b687.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Over 1,000 puzzles included![/h2][p]
From classic sizes like 10x10, 15x15, and 20x20, giant linked puzzles that come together as one big picture― Every puzzle you solve reveals new illustrations to decorate your room!

Create a beautiful space for Miku and the Piapro characters to hang out, just the way you like it!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693931/a0f3176ac9ef5b55cc65a21effc031b5c5639a95.jpg"][/img]
Solve, collect, and have even more fun with Miku!

[b]Clear puzzles to unlock:[/b]
[list]
[*]  Collect adorable illustrations!
[*]  Unlock songs featuring Hatsune Miku and the Piapro characters!
[*]  Character costumes for Miku, and Piapro characters―mix and match your favorite looks!
[/list]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693931/ac116268d49bb58ab7b63ff0aabf233073d2e0d6.jpg"][/img]
And that’s not all! Join our special giveaway event—open until July 31st (PST) —for a chance to win a 1/7 scale “Hatsune Miku: Beauty Looking Back Ver.” figure or a limited-edition acrylic block!

Don’t miss your chance to join and grab some exclusive Miku goodies!

[url="https://plaza-us.komodo.jp/pages/hatsune-miku-logic-paint-s-launch-giveaway"]https://plaza-us.komodo.jp/pages/hatsune-miku-logic-paint-s-launch-giveaway[/url]

[b]■Available on:[/b]
Steam / Nintendo Switch / XBOX One / PS4 / PS5
[/p]

notes.title: 「Version 1.1.1」Update
notes.content:
Dear Hatsune Miku fans,

Happy New Year!! Thanks again for everyone's support on Hatune Miku Logica Paint S! 

During the holiday season, we have received quite a few reports of being unable to turn off Assist Mode and unintended behavior on achievements. Everyone on the team worked hard on fixing the issues right after they got back to their desks, and we are happy to let you know that we have just released [b]"Version 1.1.1"[/b] today!

The update details are as follows.
[list]
[*] Assist Mode
     - Fixed the issue where the Assist Mode will not save values when changing the state in "Version 1.1."
[*] Achievement unlock condition of "Hatsune Miku Logic Paint Specialist."
     - The unlock conditions were incorrect and were set for Lv3 puzzles 1-8.
     - Fixed the issue where the achievement could be unlocked by clearing all special puzzles.
     ※Users who have already cleared all the special puzzles can unlock the achievements by starting the game again.
     ※If the achievement is not unlocked immediately after clearing all the special puzzles, you should be able to unlock it by restarting the game.
[*] About music playback
     - Fixed the issue where certain songs could not be played normally when playing songs. 
[*]About "How to Play"
     - Fixed the order of the "How to play" images in "Options".
 [/list]
By the way... You can find instructions for solving all puzzles in the "Community" -> "Guides" section.
If you have stumbled on a particular puzzle and can't get through it, we hope you'll be able to take advantage of it.
※Thank to "Na," the creator of the guides!

Cheers,

notes.title: 「Version 1.1」Update
notes.content:
Dear Hatsune Miku fans,

We would like to thank everyone's patience. Through the "Version 1.1" update, we added the long-awaited mouse support and many other requested features. Furthermore, community items are also available right now!

The update details are as follows
[list]
[*] Added mouse support
       - Left-click to "Confirm," right-click to execute the same operation as "Esc." 
            ※This does not apply while playing puzzles
       - Left-click to "Paint," right-click- to "Check," and middle-click to "Mark."
[*] Keyboard Configuration
       - You can use A to Z, 1 to 0, Num0 to 1, and Enter.
       - Arrow keys, Esc and Spacebar are not allowed
[*] Resolution settings
       - You can turn on or off "full-screen mode" from the options
       - You can adjust the size of the "window mode" in the options
            ※This will be disabled while playing on Steam Deck
[*] Update language
       - Modified Finnish translation based on player suggestions
[/list]
The contents of community items are as follows
[list]
[*] Badge level 1-5 + special Foil badge x1
[*] Trading cards x 6
[*] Profile Background x 6
[*] Emoticon x 6
[/list]
Have a good holiday playing with Hatsune Miku and her friends!

Cheers,

notes.title: The first patch is here, with more to come soon.
notes.content:
Dear Hatsune Miku fans,

As a first step, we have fixed the display issue of Simplified Chinese in this patch. Additionally, we have received many different suggestions for improving the game in future patches since launch. We are currently investigating all of these options, and will be trying to implement what we can to make the game the best it can be for everyone, but we will need a bit more time to address these issues. Thank you for your patience.

On another note, we will also be adding Steam community items in the very near future!

notes.title: Hatsune Miku Logic Paint S is coming to Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42810078/11fffa40fec9164935dca9e2db13f6b0db44e4e9.jpg[/img]
We are happy to announce that the critically-acclaimed puzzle game "Hatsune Miku Logic Paint S," currently available on the Microsoft® Store and Nintendo Switch™, is coming to Steam.

Store Page Open
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2089350
Add it to your wishlist to get news on the release and discounts.

[h3]About Hatsune Miku Logic Paint S[/h3]
In Hatsune Miku Logic Paint S, complete puzzles by filling in the squares using the numbers at the top and left of the grid. This game came out in March 2021 as Crypton's first puzzle game for the Nintendo Switch, and has now been ported to Steam so that more people can enjoy it.
[h3]Game Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Over 350 puzzles included![/b]
New 5×5, 15×15, and 20×20 puzzles have been added along with renewed puzzles from the Hatsune Miku Logic Paint - MIKULOGI - smartphone app!
Complete lots of stages to collect gorgeous illustrations!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42810078/b41f9c6db1c995eaaac2a2ad9675007d8b96ebac.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42810078/423da5a2064005bad831f6d7bb98f82d5d3bba25.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Piapro contest songs included![/b]
Clear puzzle missions to earn Stars!
You can unlock songs by collecting a certain number of Stars. ♪
Set your favorite songs to play on the home screen and puzzle screens!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42810078/0fcadc13bcaa99168af3c9c4295f4eec4ffa4622.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Now you can choose your favorite characters![/b]
Enjoy puzzles together with your favorite Piapro Characters in Miku and friends' room!
They'll cheer you on as you work on the puzzles!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42810078/2268e410fad2ff5a0e72420c1720788031cc1202.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[h3]References[/h3]
Hatsune Miku: https://piapro.net
She is a "software" developed by Crypton Future Media, Inc. that allows anyone to sing songs by entering lyrics and melodies. The movement took off once many creators posted the music they made with Hatsune Miku to the internet. Hatsune Miku has also attracted attention as a multi-faceted, virtual singer character, dabbling in live performances as well as merchandise, and her popularity is spreading throughout the world.

Piapro Characters: https://piapro.net/pages/character
The collective term for Hatsune Miku, Kagamine Rin, Kagamine Len, Megurine Luka, MEIKO, and KAITO. All are virtual singer software characters created by Crypton Future Media, Inc.
